home.hiddenTitle: PROLOG Cycling | Women's Competitive Cycling Team
home.heroText: We're a new name in the women's peloton, built differently from day one.
home.raisingLevel: Raising the level of women's cycling.
home.mediaText: PROLOG Cycling exists to push women's cycling forward, not by doing things the traditional way, but by rethinking how a team is built.

developmentFirst.title: Development First
developmentFirst.body: We're here to grow the sport itself: more riders, more opportunity, more depth in the women's peloton.

dataOverGuesswork.title: Data Over Guesswork
dataOverGuesswork.body: Individual training plans, testing, and metabolic profiling. Every rider's progress is measured, not assumed.

differentStructure.title: A Different Structure
differentStructure.body: Riders selected on data and numbers, not connections. A team built around the people racing, not around hierarchy.

home.roadmapIntro: We've mapped the road from first race to the Women's WorldTour, 2027 to 2032. No shortcuts, no guesswork: here's exactly how we get there.
home.roadmapHint: Tap a step to see more.
home.contactHeading: Have a question, or want to partner with us?
home.contactIntro: Send us a message and we'll get back to you.

points: Races accross Germany on different levels
2027.detail: We start as an amateur club team, racing locally while documenting every step, building an audience and a training system before we ever chase a UCI licence.

2028.detail: Stepping up to Germany's national league. Real competition, real results, and the first commercial partner riding alongside us.

2029.detail: Registering as a UCI Continental team opens the door to the international calendar. This is where we formally enter professional cycling's structure.

2030.detail: A stronger roster and a full European racing programme, aimed squarely at a start in the Women's WorldTour.

2032.detail: The destination: full ProTeam status and a start in the Women's WorldTour, proving the model works from zero.

hero.title: Building Germany's most-watched women's racing team.
hero.subtitle: Our roadmap from club team to the Women's WorldTour, 2027 to 2032.

opportunity.heading: The fastest-growing property in European sport

problem.heading: Reaching cycling audiences keeps getting more expensive

paidSocial.title: Paid social costs more every year
paidSocial.body: CPMs rise, campaigns end and you own nothing afterwards. The spend leaves no asset behind.

passiveSponsorship.title: Traditional team sponsorship is passive
passiveSponsorship.body: A logo on a jersey is unmeasurable and undifferentiated. You are one of fifteen.

topTier.title: The top tier is priced out of reach
topTier.body: A men's WorldTour team costs €5–15m a year and still buys you a logo.

problem.callout: You need attention, attribution and a story. A jersey logo delivers none of them.

whatWeAre.body: Every other team races first and hopes coverage follows. We invert it: we build the audience, and the audience funds the racing.
whatWeAre.statLabel: of our first-year budget goes to content production
whatWeAre.statNote: No team at our level does this.

roadmap.heading: Six years to the ProTeam tier
roadmap.caption: Continental registration in 2029 is the point at which we enter the UCI system. Everything before it is preparation; everything after it is progression.

2027.detail: 10.000 followers on Instagram. Foundation built in public.

whyUs.heading: Four things no other team at this level has

audience.title: An audience before the first race
audience.body: Content production starts before racing does. The story is already being filmed.

performance.title: In-house performance department
performance.body: Individual training plans with testing and metabolic profiling. We invest in every rider.

technical.title: Technical capability built-in
technical.body: Our founder builds and maintains the software. Data, analytics and content infrastructure, developed in-house at zero cost.

vision.title: Modern vision on cycling and business
vision.body: Cycling has always worked as a B2B network, and we build that in deliberately: riders selected on data and numbers, not connections.

engine.heading: Three layers, running continuously

document.title: Document a journey
document.body: Ongoing story of development from zero to hero. The asset your brand attaches to, and the reason people come back.

daily.title: Daily content
daily.body: 5–7 Reels/Posts/Stories per week. Reach at the top of the funnel, produced at near-zero marginal cost.

channels.title: Rider channels
channels.body: Every rider contract includes content obligations. Eight distribution points, not one.

engine.calloutStrong: Building a professional cycling team from nothing.
engine.calloutBody: Your brand is in the story from season one. That position cannot be bought later.

package.heading: Not a logo. A measurable media package.
items: Guaranteed monthly impressions and watch-time, reported to you.
Product integrated into content, not pasted onto it.
Content we produce is yours to use.
Athlete access for your own campaigns.
A named position in a growth story you can tell internally for a decade.
package.callout: We contract on media delivered, not on exposure hoped for.

tiers.heading: Three levels. One founding position.
tiers.footerCaption: One founding partner. Ever. The position cannot be created again.

measurement.heading: What you sign off on

monthly.title: Monthly reporting
monthly.body: Impressions, watch-time minutes, engagement rate and audience demographics, delivered every month.

benchmarked.title: Benchmarked value
benchmarked.body: Earned media value measured against equivalent paid social spend.

attribution.title: Direct attribution
attribution.body: Trackable links and discount codes so revenue can be traced, not estimated.

targets.title: Contracted targets
targets.body: Media targets written into the agreement. Quarterly review.

measurement.calloutStrong: Year one is priced on risk we carry, not risk you carry.
measurement.calloutBody: We take a reduced fee in year one, escalating only against delivered metrics. If we miss the numbers, you pay less.

people.heading: Who is building this
people.footerCaption: Sponsors fund people before they fund plans.

closing.subtitle: The only question is whose name is on the jersey.
